notices.name: ERCOT
notices.title: ERCOT Advisory
notices.text: ERCOT issued an Advisory (South Texas Import Interface).

messages.content: I’ll lock in a feasible DA arbitrage position, then adjust the physical schedule as RT prices and notices arrive. The current notices refer to May 8, so I won’t assume they apply to May 9.

The battery is full at noon, with 160 MWh of discharge allowance remaining. I’ll spread that discharge across 15:00, 16:00, and 19:00, retaining 40 MWh for a decision at the 18:00 watch. This sacrifices a little DA-price-based value for flexibility if RT conditions change.

RT prices have risen to $378.52/MWh, and ERCOT has issued a South Texas Import Interface advisory. I’ll move the remaining discharge into 14:00–16:00—the earliest open window—rather than hold energy for the evening.
